import { MeshStandardNodeMaterial, MeshBasicNodeMaterial } from 'three/webgpu';
import { uv, mix, color } from 'three/tsl';
import { gsap } from 'gsap';

export default function createNode(config, ctx) {
  const { Group, PlaneGeometry, Mesh, PointLight, DirectionalLight } = ctx.THREE;
  const group = new Group();

  const disposables = [];
  const timelines = [];
  const primitiveCleanups = [];

  // 1. Stage Backdrop (z = -2.5) mapping visual gradient stops
  const bgGeom = new PlaneGeometry(8, 6);
  const bgMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial();
  bgMat.colorNode = mix(color('#0b0b10'), color('#16161d'), uv().y);
  
  const bgMesh = new Mesh(bgGeom, bgMat);
  bgMesh.position.z = -2.5;
  group.add(bgMesh);
  disposables.push(bgGeom, bgMat);

  // 2. Structured Lighting for dark/machined-metal product shot aesthetic
  const keyLight = new DirectionalLight('#e8ecf2', 1.1);
  keyLight.position.set(2, 3, 4);
  group.add(keyLight);

  const rimLight = new PointLight('#ff2a38', 1.2, 7); // Signal Red Rim accent
  rimLight.position.set(-2.5, 2, 1);
  group.add(rimLight);

  // 3. Central Textured Hero card/plane
  const cardGeom = new PlaneGeometry(3.6, 2.25);
  const cardMat = new MeshStandardNodeMaterial({
    roughness: 0.52,
    metalness: 0.55,
    transparent: true,
    opacity: 0.95
  });
  
  const cardMesh = new Mesh(cardGeom, cardMat);
  cardMesh.position.set(0, 0.2, 0);
  group.add(cardMesh);
  disposables.push(cardGeom, cardMat);

  // Soft Radial Contact Shadow below the subject
  const shadowGeom = new PlaneGeometry(3.8, 0.4);
  const shadowMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({
    color: '#000000',
    transparent: true,
    opacity: 0.55
  });
  const shadowMesh = new Mesh(shadowGeom, shadowMat);
  shadowMesh.position.set(0, -1.0, -0.05);
  shadowMesh.rotation.x = -Math.PI * 0.45;
  group.add(shadowMesh);
  disposables.push(shadowGeom, shadowMat);

  // Secure texture loading
  const imgUrl = config.imageUrl || '/prism-mock/home/nodes/feature-card.png';
  if (imgUrl) {
    ctx.textureLoader.loadTexture(imgUrl).then((tex) => {
      cardMat.map = tex;
      cardMat.needsUpdate = true;
    }).catch((err) => console.warn('Texture failed to load safely:', err));
  }

  // 4. Create text via context's Font Atlas with correct display styling
  const textItems = config.textContent ?? config.intent?.visualSpec?.textContent ?? [];
  const textString = textItems[0]?.text ?? "A machined-metal watch atelier landing with catalog, pricing, jo";

  const textObj = ctx.fontAtlas.createText(textString, {
    fontSize: 0.12,
    color: '#e8ecf2',
    align: 'center',
    maxWidthPx: 560
  });
  textObj.position.set(0, -1.3, 0.15);
  group.add(textObj);

  // 5. Entrance Timelines & Weight Motion
  const tl = gsap.timeline();
  timelines.push(tl);
  
  tl.fromTo(cardMesh.position, 
    { y: -0.2, z: -0.4 }, 
    { y: 0.2, z: 0, duration: 1.1, ease: 'power4.out' }
  );
  
  tl.fromTo(cardMesh.rotation, 
    { x: -0.08 }, 
    { x: 0, duration: 1.1, ease: 'power4.out' }, 
    '<'
  );

  tl.fromTo(textObj.position,
    { y: -1.45 },
    { y: -1.3, duration: 0.9, ease: 'power3.out' },
    '-=0.7'
  );

  // 6. Support optional Cinematic Primitives safely
  const prims = config.cinematicPrimitives || [];
  prims.forEach((prim) => {
    if (ctx.primitives[prim.name]) {
      const pInstance = ctx.primitives[prim.name](group, prim.params);
      if (pInstance) {
        if (pInstance.timeline) timelines.push(pInstance.timeline);
        if (pInstance.cleanup) primitiveCleanups.push(pInstance.cleanup);
      }
    }
  });

  // 7. Robust Cleanup Lifecycle Hook binding
  group.userData = {
    handlers: {},
    cleanup: function() {
      timelines.forEach(t => t.kill());
      primitiveCleanups.forEach(c => {
        if (typeof c === 'function') c();
      });
      disposables.forEach(d => {
        if (d && typeof d.dispose === 'function') d.dispose();
      });
    }
  };

  return group;
}
